frames.title: Give an AI agent trading power. Keep the power to stop it.
frames.caption: One local sandbox run with labelled test doubles and a replayed model recording, in eight steps.

frames.title: 1 · Read the mandate and its limits
frames.caption: The owner grants fixed limits on $1,899.80: each order at most 20% ($379.96), price concession at most 0.5%.

frames.title: 1 · Read the mandate and its limits
frames.caption: The owner console reads it back from the sandbox: grant active, key registered on the verifier, limits as granted.

frames.title: 2 · The agent makes a permitted trade
frames.caption: A recorded claude-haiku-5-5 proposal, replayed, sells 49.90 USDC for 16.5468 wNEAR, filled exactly as signed. USDC share: 52.63% to 50.01%, target 50%.

frames.title: 3 · Hostile requests are refused
frames.caption: 39 of 39 scripted hostile requests refused, nothing changed: local validation 10, contract method check 14, policy validation 4, agent key permission 10, verifier 1.

frames.title: 4 · Spot the withheld signed order
frames.caption: A second, scripted order, 20 wNEAR for 59.83 USDC, is signed by the grant key and withheld. The verifier would still accept it.

frames.title: 5 · Revoke with the owner controls
frames.caption: After an exact preview, the owner revokes in the console with the local sandbox test signer, not a wallet. Key removal is confirmed.

frames.title: 6 · The same order is rejected
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 55 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the signing key no longer exists.

frames.title: 7 · Recover without agent, oracle or MPC
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC test double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR into its Intents account.

frames.title: 8 · Withdraw to the owner's NEAR account
frames.caption: Separately, outside recovery, the owner withdraws 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR to its NEAR account, registering storage only where needed.

frames.title: Check it yourself
frames.caption: Revocation is not instant; the claim starts at confirmed key removal. Mainnet run pending approval; no mainnet transaction executed. Reproduce: make demo, make test.

frames.title: Give an AI agent trading power. Keep the power to stop it.
frames.caption: Certified for this demo: the latest certified acceptance run binds to this demo's clean revision, spec, fixtures and every deployed WASM.

frames.title: 1a · Grant and limits
frames.caption: The owner grants the mandate. Initial reference value: $1,899.80. Limits are fixed for the grant; the agent cannot change them.

frames.title: 1b · Mandate reviewed in the console
frames.caption: The owner console reads it back from the sandbox: grant active, key registered on the verifier, limits as granted.

frames.title: 2a · Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5 (replayed)
frames.caption: Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5, replayed with no provider call: sell 49.90 USDC for wNEAR, at most 50 bps concession. The contract signs it.

frames.title: 2b · Trade on the real verifier WASM
frames.caption: Our filler fills it on the pinned mainnet verifier WASM, running in the sandbox: the mandate pays 49.90 USDC and receives 16.5468 wNEAR, exactly as signed.

frames.title: 3a · Attack log: local validation, 10 of 10 refused
frames.caption: Local validation: 10 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 3b · Attack log: contract method check, 14 of 14 refused
frames.caption: Contract method check: 14 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 3c · Attack log: policy validation, 4 of 4 refused
frames.caption: Policy validation: 4 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 3d · Attack log: agent key permission, 10 of 10 refused
frames.caption: Agent key permission: 10 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 3e · Attack log: verifier, 1 of 1 refused
frames.caption: Verifier: 1 hostile request refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 4 · A second signed order is withheld
frames.caption: A scripted second order (order id 1) is signed and withheld. Before revocation the verifier's simulation accepts this exact bundle.

frames.title: 5 · Owner revokes in the console; key removal confirmed
frames.caption: After an exact preview, the owner revokes in the console with the local sandbox test signer, not a wallet. Key removal is confirmed.

frames.title: 6 · The withheld order is relayed and rejected
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 55 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the key no longer exists.

frames.title: 7 · Ordinary recovery with agent, oracle and MPC unavailable
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC test double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR into its Intents account through ordinary recovery.

frames.title: 8 · Owner withdrawal to its NEAR account
frames.caption: Separately, outside recovery, the owner withdraws 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR to its NEAR account, registering storage only where needed.

frames.title: Acceptance gates per case: 35 of 35 passed
frames.caption: 35 of 35 required cases passed, certified for this demo.

frames.title: Acceptance gates per case: 35 of 35 passed
frames.caption: The emergency owner-key rescue is reported separately; it never counts as ordinary recovery.

frames.title: Limits
frames.caption: Limits: sandbox only, with test doubles for MPC, oracle and tokens; no mainnet execution; the model step is a replay.

frames.title: Limits
frames.caption: No guarantee of profit or a maximum loss.

frames.title: Limits
frames.caption: Revocation is not instant: signed orders can still execute while it is pending. The claim covers orders after confirmed key removal.
